description: Phlex UI components (a port of Appica UI) with Tailwind v4 classes and Stimulus controllers. UI holds the primitives, Blocks the compositions. Each entry's `schema` file lists the props, the compound parts (with where each renders), and working examples.

kits.UI: include UI in a Phlex view, then call Button(...), Select(...) { … }
kits.Blocks: include Blocks (and UI) to use compositions like ReviewSummary(...)

theme: Colors come from CSS variables (ui/theme.css). Override them after importing ui/index.css; never replace theme.css.

components.name: ChatAssistant
components.summary: An assistant chat card: a header, the conversation, a "thinking" status, suggestion chips and a composer - the Appica homepage's assistant, composed from UI primitives.

components.name: CommandMenu
components.summary: A command palette card: a search field with a ⌘K hint, grouped commands with icons and keyboard shortcuts, and a footer of key hints - composed from Input, Kbd, Navigation and Icon.

components.name: MusicPlayer
components.summary: A now-playing card: cover art, title and artist with a favorite toggle, a seek bar with elapsed and remaining time, and shuffle / previous / play-pause / next / repeat controls - composed from Toggle, Button, Slider and Icon.

components.name: Newsletter
components.summary: A newsletter signup: a heading, a pitch, a list of perks, an email form with a spam honeypot and a note, and social links - composed from Field, Input, Button, Thumbnail and Icon.

components.name: OrderTracker
components.summary: A shipment card: the order number and total, a status badge, the delivery progress, a timeline of steps and the courier - composed from Badge, Progress, Icon, Separator, Avatar and Button.

components.name: ProductCard
components.summary: A product card: a photo with a discount badge and a wishlist toggle, the name, price and original price, and whatever the block adds (sizes, quantity, the cart button) - composed from Badge, Toggle, Button, ToggleGroup and NumberField.

components.name: RevenueSummary
components.summary: A revenue overview card: the period's total with a trend badge against the previous period, top markets, a trend chart and a row of key stats - composed from Badge, Icon and Sparkline.

components.name: ReviewSummary
components.summary: A product-reviews card: the average score with stars and a review count, the breakdown by stars and a social-proof footer - composed from Rating, Meter, Separator and AvatarGroup.

components.name: TeamMembers
components.summary: A team card: the member list with roles and presence, a seat count and an invite-by-email form - composed from Avatar, Badge, Button, Icon and Separator.

components.name: ThemeCustomizer
components.summary: A theme settings panel like Appica's: mode, base / primary / secondary colors (a Tailwind scale or any custom color), font and radius, "Get CSS Code", "Disable animations" and a reset - composed from ToggleGroup, Select, Input, Switch, Button, Dialog and CopyButton.

components.name: Transactions
components.summary: A recent-transactions card: a title, All / Income / Spending filter tabs and a list of Transaction rows - composed from Tabs, Thumbnail and Icon.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A prominent, in-page message about a status or event - a banner that lives in the layout.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.summary: A dialog that demands a response - a destructive or high-stakes confirmation.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.summary: Root of the compound component.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A user image with a text or icon fallback when it's missing.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A small label that highlights a status, count, or category.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Where the current page sits in a hierarchy: a `<nav>` landmark around a trail of links.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Appica's Button.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Buttons joined into one control: inner corners squared, shared borders overlapped.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A flexible content container for a title, description, media and actions.

components.name: Carousel
components.summary: A draggable, swipeable slider built on Embla Carousel, with autoplay, fade, auto-height, thumbnails and scroll effects.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A tick box on a native <input type="checkbox">, sized in em so it follows the text size.

components.name: Chip
components.summary: A compact pill for tags, attributes, filters and removable tokens, in Button's palette.

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: A section that expands and collapses to show or hide its content.

components.name: Combobox
components.summary: Pick a value (or several) from a list you can filter by typing - Autocomplete's sibling for selection: the value is one of the items, the input reverts to its label when you leave, and it submits under `name:` from hidden inputs.

components.name: ContextMenu
components.summary: A menu of actions for an object, opened by right-clicking (or long-pressing) it.

components.name: CopyButton
components.summary: A Button that copies text to the clipboard, then swaps its icon for a drawn check.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A focused task or content that interrupts the page, in a centered modal.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Root of the compound component: holds the edge (`side:`) and the drawer options and shares them with its parts.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.summary: A menu of actions opened from a button.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Wires a label, description and error message to one control - Input, Textarea, Select… - and validates it.

components.name: FormBuilderAutocomplete
components.summary: An Autocomplete (free text with suggestions) with its input and list, as UI::FormBuilder renders it.

components.name: Icon
components.summary: One of the ~5,000 Appica icons (https://appica.dev/ui/icons), by its canonical name.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A single-line text field, with optional start/end adornments and a clear button.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keyboard key or shortcut, e.g.

components.name: Loader
components.summary: An indeterminate "working on it" indicator for section- and status-level waits.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: A brand logo: a circular mark (drawn with Phlex's SVG builder) plus a wordmark.

components.name: Menubar
components.summary: A bar of menus for an app's top-level commands (File / Edit / View …).

components.name: Meter
components.summary: A static measurement inside a known range - disk usage, a score, remaining battery.

components.name: Navigation
components.summary: Links between pages or sections, with the current one highlighted.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.summary: Site navigation whose items open rich panels of links - Appica's mega-menu.

components.name: NumberField
components.summary: A numeric input between − and + steppers, formatting its value (currency, percent, units…).

components.name: OTPField
components.summary: A one-time code split into single-character slots.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Page links for a long list: a `<nav>` landmark around a row of links you lay out yourself - or let PaginationPages build the truncated range for you.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Rich, interactive content floating beside a control - a form, settings, a share sheet.

components.name: PreviewCard
components.summary: A rich preview of a link, shown while it's hovered or focused - the profile behind an

components.name: Progress
components.summary: The completion status of a task that takes a while - an upload, an import, an install.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: One option of a RadioGroup: a native <input type="radio"> sized in em, so it follows the text.

components.name: Rating
components.summary: A score input: a row of stars (or any icon pair) that fills from the start up to the value, with fractional steps, a hover preview, keyboard control and a hidden form input.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A button that opens a list of options to pick one (or several with `multiple: true`).

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A thin horizontal or vertical line between sections of related content.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: A placeholder block shown while content loads.

components.name: Slider
components.summary: A value (or a range) picked along a track.

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: Root of the sparkline compound component.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A small spinning indicator for compact, in-place waits (a button, an icon button, an overlay).

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on/off toggle for a setting that applies right away: a native checkbox with role="switch".

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Several panels sharing one region, one shown at a time.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A multi-line text field - Input's appearance, variants and sizes for a <textarea>.

components.name: Thumbnail
components.summary: A compact preview tile beside a file, a list row or a media item: an image cropped to fill (falling back to a placeholder icon while it loads or when it fails), or a colored tile framing an icon.

components.name: Toast
components.summary: One toast: a title, optional description, leading icon, action button and close button.

components.name: Toc
components.summary: An "on this page" sidebar that highlights the links whose headings are in view.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A two-state button (aria-pressed).

components.name: Toolbar
components.summary: A strip of controls with one tab stop: the arrow keys move between its items along `orientation:`, Home / End jump to the ends.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short, non-interactive hint shown while its trigger is hovered or focused.
